correctness.rationale: A planar alpha representative yields a simple q-gon whose survival forces r >= sqrt(d^2-t^2); the sharp perimeter bound for a q-gon surrounding a disk gives r <= t cot(pi/q). Their combination yields d/b <= csc(pi/m), and perturbation stability removes general-position assumptions. The regular m-gon attains equality.

originality.rationale: The recent persistent-isoperimetric work proves only the general large-rho asymptotic point threshold, while targeted searches found no exact finite planar formula csc(pi/m) or ceil(pi/arcsin(1/rho)); adjacent exact persistence-set work is for Vietoris-Rips rather than the planar Cech extremum. Current SCOPE archive searches found no overlapping record.

value.rationale: The theorem exactly solves the finite k=1,d=2 instance of the deterministic extremal problem behind the new universal law, replacing N_rho ~ pi rho by a complete sharp formula for every target persistence and identifying the finite polygonal mechanism.
